# Australian Psychological Society (APS)

> Peak professional body representing 24,000+ psychologists in Australia, providing member services, training, advocacy, and public information about psychology services.

The Australian Psychological Society (APS) is the leading organization for psychologists in Australia, offering professional development, member resources, career guidance, and advocacy on mental health policy. The site serves both psychology professionals and the general public seeking information about psychological services and support.

## Key Topics

- Australian Psychological Society (APS)
- Psychology registration and AHPRA requirements
- Medicare rebates and psychologist costs
- Professional development and CPD training
- CBT and DBT therapeutic approaches
- Member services and resources
- Psychology careers and study pathways
- Mental health support and services
- School psychology and student wellbeing
- Advocacy and psychology policy
- NDIS and disability support
- Psychology Board of Australia (PsyBA)
- Finding and selecting a psychologist
- Overseas qualifications assessment (APAC)
- Workplace and organizational psychology

## Organization & Membership

- [Australian Psychological Society | APS](https://psychology.org.au): APS homepage: Peak professional body for 24,000+ psychologists in Australia
- [About us | APS](https://psychology.org.au/about-us): APS organizational overview, governance, and member group information
- [Members | APS](https://psychology.org.au/members): Member portal with CPD logging, resources, and professional development tools
- [Community | APS](https://psychology.org.au/community): APS community engagement and advocacy initiatives with social issues focus
- [Advocacy | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/advocacy): APS advocacy, policy work, and community wellbeing initiatives

## Psychology Services & Public Information

- [Psychology | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology): Main psychology overview page covering services, Medicare rebates, and help
- [About psychology | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/about-psychology): Guide to finding right psychologist with costs, types, and FAQ information
- [How can psychology help me? | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/about-psychology/what-is-psychology): Definition of psychology, AHPRA registration requirements, and mental health support
- [What does a psychologist do? | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/about-psychology/what-does-a-psychologist-do): Overview of psychologist roles, assessment, therapy, and workplace psychology
- [How much does seeing a psychologist cost? | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/about-psychology/what-it-costs): Psychologist fees, Medicare rebates, and APS suggested fee schedule guide
- [Support to schools | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/about-psychology/what-does-a-psychologist-do/psychologists-in-schools): School psychology services, student wellbeing, and behavioral assessment support

## Training & Professional Development

- [Training & Events | APS](https://psychology.org.au/training-events): CPD training courses including DBT, CBT, webinars, and professional development

## Careers & Education

- [Careers and studying psychology | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/careers-and-studying-psychology): Career and study options, registration requirements, PsychXchange job board
- [Careers in psychology | APS](https://psychology.org.au/careers): Psychology career paths across business, education, health, and sports sectors
- [Studying psychology | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/careers-and-studying-psychology/studying-psychology): Psychology degree options, study pathways, and professional registration requirements
- [Study pathways | APS](https://psychology.org.au/psychology/careers-and-studying-psychology/studying-psychology/study-pathways): Psychology education sequence, accreditation, internship pathways, and registration

## Professional Assessment & Credentials

- [Assessment of overseas qualifications | APS](https://psychology.org.au/about-us/what-we-do/assessments/assessment-overseas-qualifications): APAC overseas qualification assessment for skilled migration psychology professionals
